look_here_first: Moist-ground sedge with moderately broad leaves and plump perigynia ending in a short but distinct beak.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local in the repaired Master Plant Pool; ITIS and FNA accept the species.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active learning; native metrics remain excluded until later county reconciliation.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Carex species are often separated by perigynium shape, beak, venation, and spike arrangement.
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Broader-leaved and more robust than C. texensis; lacks the broad white winged perigynia of C. tetrastachya.
